decisions.reason: As a finish variant close to the firm’s core drainage range, it fits existing design and manufacturing knowledge, and the firm’s own R&D makes improvement and market learning feasible despite only limited website prominence so far.

This shower channel is very close to the firm’s established drainage competence, was given a dedicated page, and should benefit from the firm’s strong related knowledge, service network, and in-house development.

Although related to the firm’s drainage offer, the pump-assisted element is somewhat more complex and slightly further from its traditional knowledge base, so it carries more uncertainty but remains supportable because the firm has its own R&D.
A tileable floor drain with grating sits squarely within the firm’s long-standing drainage expertise, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough commitment and learning potential to retain it.
This stainless steel design grate is highly aligned with the firm’s existing product architecture and design-led positioning, so absorptive capacity is strong and the likelihood of withdrawal is low.
